EarthPulse AI is an interactive Earth observation exploration platform developed by Team ORBIVANTA for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It aims to make understanding changes in Earth's interconnected systems more accessible through a unified, visual investigation experience.

The platform helps users explore available Earth-related information, navigate its investigation tools, and understand environmental patterns through the features and visualizations provided by the application. By focusing on key questions—what is changing, where is it happening, and how can the observed information be interpreted—EarthPulse AI addresses the challenge of turning complex Earth observations into understandable insights.

The project emphasizes accessible exploration, clear presentation of information, and the importance of reliable scientific data. Its goal is to encourage curiosity, support evidence-based investigation, and help users discover the story behind our changing planet.
details:
EarthPulse AI – Project Details

EarthPulse AI is an interactive Earth System Trend Detective platform designed to make exploring and understanding changes in Earth's systems more accessible. Developed by Team ORBIVANTA, the project focuses on helping users investigate Earth-related information through an integrated visual interface.

What does it do and how does it work?

EarthPulse AI provides a visual environment for exploring Earth system information and interacting with the investigation capabilities available in the application. Its workflow is centred around discovering relevant information, navigating the available exploration tools, examining visual representations, and understanding the patterns presented.

The platform is designed around four important scientific questions:

  • What is changing?
  • Where is it changing?
  • How much is it changing?
  • What can we understand from the available evidence?

Rather than treating environmental information as isolated numbers, EarthPulse aims to make exploration more intuitive through its application interface, visual presentation, and investigation-oriented approach.

Benefits and intended impact

Earth observation information can be complex and difficult for non-specialists to interpret. EarthPulse AI aims to reduce this barrier by making environmental exploration more accessible and understandable.

Its intended benefits include:

  • Making Earth system exploration more approachable.
  • Helping users understand environmental information through visual interaction.
  • Encouraging curiosity about changes occurring across our planet.
  • Supporting more informed, evidence-oriented investigation.
  • Making scientific exploration easier to communicate and understand.

Our long-term vision is to encourage students, researchers, and curious individuals to explore Earth's changing systems and develop a stronger understanding of environmental patterns.

Tools and technologies used

The project was developed using:

  • Frontend: React and TypeScript.
  • Development environment: Visual Studio Code.
  • Development and prototyping: Google AI Studio.
  • Build tooling: Vite and npm.
  • Version control and collaboration: Git and GitHub.

Creativity and innovation

The creative aspect of EarthPulse AI lies in approaching Earth observation as an investigation rather than simply displaying environmental information. The platform is designed around scientific questions, visual exploration, and the discovery of meaningful patterns.

Its identity combines a space-inspired visual experience with an investigation-focused interface, encouraging users to think like Earth system detectives.

Factors considered during development

Our team considered several important factors:

  1. Accessibility: Making the experience understandable and approachable for different types of users.
  2. Scientific credibility: Recognising the importance of trustworthy data, transparent sources, and responsible interpretation.
  3. Visual clarity: Presenting information in a way that is easier to explore and understand.
  4. Usability: Creating an interface that encourages exploration without overwhelming users.
  5. Scalability: Building a foundation that can support further Earth observation exploration capabilities.
  6. Scientific responsibility: Avoiding unsupported conclusions and recognising the importance of data quality, uncertainty, and limitations.

Through EarthPulse AI, Team ORBIVANTA aims to make the exploration of our changing planet more accessible, engaging, and meaningful.

Our vision: One Planet. Countless Signals. Discover the Story of Our Changing Earth.
